rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an investigation or inquiry process.

example.english: We’re still carrying out an investigation, and there are no results yet.
example.traditional: 我哋仲做緊調查，未有結果。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 zou6 gan2 diu6 caa4 mei6 jau5 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a police or criminal investigation rather than a general inquiry.

example.english: The police are conducting an investigation into the case.
example.traditional: 警方正就案件進行偵查。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zing3 zau6 on3 gin6 zeon3 hang4 zing1 caa4

rows.note: Use this for an inquiry seeking information or clarification, not for a full-scale investigation.

example.english: If you need an investigation into your application status, feel free to call us.
example.traditional: 如要查詢申請進度，歡迎致電我哋。
example.jyutping: jyu4 jiu3 caa4 seon1 san1 cing2 zeon3 dou6 fun1 jing4 zi3 din6 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this when the investigation means patient or systematic research, especially in an academic or technical context.

example.english: This topic deserves a thorough investigation.
example.traditional: 呢個課題值得慢慢研究。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 tai4 zik6 dak1 maan6 maan6 jin4 gau3
